findings.now: So for now we have to give up on the hour-long breakthrough that therapy aims for, since an hour spent working on the trauma itself overwhelms an armored nervous system more than it heals it.

F1.1: severity 1: the fresh reads of the post's paragraph last turn (x1126b/v1, the comment on texts_x1126b.NEW['sw22']) found that "cannot metabolize sixty minutes of trauma processing; that is a flood, not a fix" doesn't say what happens, and that a reader with years of hour-long therapy hears that it harmed them; "overwhelms an armored nervous system more than it heals it" says what happens without telling that reader their hours were for nothing. "Sensitized" went with the fix: "armored" carries the same state here, as the section names it
